body:
## Context

1.11.0 arc follow-up (u5 items f + d2). pi's ticket and rail resolution keys on the RAW SESSION CWD while the handoff gate now resolves the enclosing repo root (outermost .adlc in the checkout): starting pi in repo/src gets handoff enforcement but no rails. Pre-existing divergence — #545 only ADDED enforcement there — but it is now visible and is the mirror image of the opencode round-5 finding (two subsystems, two definitions of "the repo").

Also from #545's final prosecution, two small pins: Q9 — the extension-level storeOverride wiring (ADLC_TICKET_STORE ?? ADLC_TICKETS at the tool_call site) is masked by session_start arming and unpinned (planting storeOverride:null passes); Q10 — the .git-file boundary check accepts leading whitespace/CRLF/BOM and no-space gitdir:/x, all rejected by real git's read_gitfile_gently; no capability gain (comment-level fix acceptable).

## What to change

Resolve tickets/rails from the same repo root the handoff gate resolves (or document + test the intended divergence if one is chosen deliberately); pin Q9 with a test where a cwd NOT armed at session_start relies on the external store per-call; align or document Q10's grammar with a comment naming the divergence from git.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Starting pi in a subdirectory yields the SAME root for rails and handoff (or the divergence is documented + pinned as intended). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 with the root-unification test present.
2. Q9 pinned: extension-level storeOverride drives arming for a fresh cwd. verify: same suite.
3. Q10 addressed (grammar aligned or divergence commented + pinned). verify: same suite; reviewer confirms the comment cites read_gitfile_gently.
title: pi: unify ticket/rail root resolution with handoff root resolution; pin storeOverride wiring and the gitdir grammar
